data.name: Carrier Cuties - Pets In Mechs!
data.detailed_description:
In Carrier Cuties, you take on the persona of a cute and cuddly house pet who pilots a Hu-mech resembling your former owner in a Co-Op battle! This is a whacky slapstick team vs team game where you and a friend take on other cute pets in epic battles.  

Inspired by classic arcade games but evolved for modern players.  With a lighthearted tone and approachable controls, this game is built for everyone, while still offering the depth and precision for skilled players.  Bring along a friend and battle against another team in a dynamic hazard filled arenas.  Battle for your pack and to fetch the all the glory and treats!

Fast paced, highly interactive combat

  • Fur-ocious Fights - White knuckled combat, where every action is make or break. Simple and intuitive controls get you into the action quickly.

  • Bear Arms - Battle over momentum shifting Power Cells.  Knockdown your opponent to eject their Power Cell and grab it for yourself.  Collect three and enter your Beast Mode unlocking powerful super attacks.

  • Bird’s Eye View - Each arena is a character itself.  Use the environment to your advantage. Hurl tables and chairs.  Knock your opponents into flaming stove tops and electrical signs for high damage. 

Collaborative plays and strategies

  • The gameplay is built for teambased play, 2v2 battles.

  • Choose your pet and hu-mechs special abilities to complement each other.  Use sticky bombs to slow down your foe while your teammate shreds them with a sonic bark.  Protect your teammate with an energy shield as they are bombarded with flaming egg drops from your opponent.

  • Execute synchronized attacks, share Power Cells, and revive each other from destruction.

Colorful cast of combatants

  • Beast Mode! - Choose from a collection of zany and outrageous characters.  Use the Boxer Hu-Mech to pummel your opponent with hydraulic powered punches and flying Rocket Fists.  Then transform into your Puppy’s Beast Mode Mech, and shatter their servos with your sonic powers barks.  Throw your fierce titanium house slipper of the Landlady with laser precision, and transform into soaring avian Parrot Mech dropping explosive egg bombs.  Every fight is a delightfully absurd battle of fur, feather, and scales.

  • Feathered Flourishes - Express yourself and your personality through a myriad of outfits and accessories for your Pets and Hu-mechs.  Customize your robot to add unique logos, color schemes, and effects.

  • Paw-R-Lay - Choose unique emotes for victory poses and taunts for your Pet and Hu-mech to show off in front of your competitors. There will be endless opportunities to flaunt your wares when you socialize with other pets in Paw-R-Lay mode.

Clay is here to play

  • A distinctive handcrafted look: each character is sculpted in clay, then scanned into the game to preserve every texture and imperfection, creating a charming, personality filled character design. 

  • Each fighter looks and feels like a toy you can reach into the screen and play with.

data.short_description: Carrier Cuties fast-paced 3D arena fighting game where Pets in Hu-Mechs battle in highly interactive and destructible environments using the surroundings to fight. Battle with a partner against two opponents to win all the glory and treats!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7500 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060 (VRAM 6GB) / Radeon RX 580 (VRAM 4GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 60 GB available space
